field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable zapret2 DPI bypass service.

field.label: WAN Interface
field.help: Select the WAN interface where DPI bypass should be applied.

field.label: Ports
field.help: Comma-separated list of ports to intercept (default: 80,443).

field.label: Additional UDP Ports
field.help: Optional UDP ports or port ranges to intercept in addition to QUIC/UDP 443, for example 19294-19344,50000-50100. Leave empty to preserve the current UDP behavior. Configure the matching UDP strategy below when this field is used. UDP port 443 cannot overlap this list when the QUIC strategy is enabled.

field.label: Source Networks
field.help:
Limit DPI bypass to traffic coming from these IPv4 networks or hosts (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 for one LAN, or 192.168.1.50 for a single device). Leave empty to apply the bypass to all traffic leaving the WAN (default).

Matching happens before NAT, so enter the clients' real LAN addresses. The firewall's own traffic is always included so the safety watchdog keeps exercising the bypass path.

field.label: Divert Port
field.help: Internal port for ipfw divert socket (default: 989). Change only if conflicting with another service.

field.label: How to find your strategy
field.text:
Run blockcheck2 from the Diagnostics page or via SSH:
cd /usr/local/etc/zapret2 && env IFACE_WAN=your_wan_if /bin/sh blockcheck2.sh

Copy the working strategy from the SUMMARY output into the fields below.
HTTP strategies go in the HTTP field, HTTPS/TLS strategies go in the HTTPS field, and HTTP/3/QUIC strategies go in the QUIC field. For additional UDP traffic, set the UDP ports, L7 protocol filter, and a UDP strategy below.

field.label: HTTP Strategy
field.help:
dvtws2 arguments for HTTP (port 80) bypass from blockcheck2 results.
Paste the part after dvtws2 from a curl_test_http line in the SUMMARY.
Example: --payload=http_req --lua-desync=http_hostcase:spell=hoSt

field.label: HTTPS Strategy
field.help:
dvtws2 arguments for HTTPS/TLS (port 443) bypass from blockcheck2 results.
Paste the part after dvtws2 from a curl_test_https_tls12 line in the SUMMARY.
Example: --payload=tls_client_hello --lua-desync=fake:blob=fake_default_tls:ip_autottl=-4,3-20:repeats=1

field.label: QUIC Strategy
field.help:
dvtws2 arguments for HTTP/3 / QUIC (UDP port 443) bypass from blockcheck2 results.
Paste the strategy part after dvtws2 from a successful HTTP/3 result.
Example: --payload=quic_initial --lua-desync=fake:blob=fake_default_quic:repeats=6

field.label: Additional UDP L7 Protocol Filter
field.help: Comma-separated zapret2 L7 protocols for the additional UDP profile. Supported values: discord, stun, wireguard, dht, quic, unknown. For Discord voice, start with discord,stun. Required together with Additional UDP Ports and UDP Strategy.

field.label: Additional UDP Strategy
field.help: Paste only verified zapret2 profile arguments of the form --payload=... and --lua-desync=..., separated by spaces. Do not include --new, --filter-udp, --filter-l7, shell syntax, or file paths. Required together with Additional UDP Ports and UDP L7 Protocol Filter. Example structure: --payload=stun --lua-desync=fake:blob=fake_default_quic:repeats=6 (strategy is illustrative; verify it with your zapret2 build and traffic).

field.label: Extra Arguments
field.help: Additional global dvtws2 arguments appended to the command line.

field.label: Enable YouTube / Google TLS Profile
field.help: Apply the separate TCP/443 strategy to the bundled Google/YouTube domain list before the generic TCP profile. Uses --filter-l7=tls.

field.label: YouTube / Google TCP Strategy
field.help: When the TCP profile is enabled, provide verified zapret2 arguments such as --payload=tls_client_hello --lua-desync=.... Do not include --new, filters, hostlists, paths, or shell syntax.

field.label: Enable YouTube / Google QUIC Profile
field.help: Apply the separate UDP/443 QUIC strategy to the bundled Google/YouTube domain list before the generic QUIC profile. Enabling this also installs the shared UDP/443 divert rule.

field.label: YouTube / Google QUIC Strategy
field.help: When the QUIC profile is enabled, provide verified zapret2 arguments such as --payload=quic_initial --lua-desync=.... Do not include --new, filters, hostlists, paths, or shell syntax.

field.label: Additional YouTube / Google Domains
field.help: Optional extra hostlist entries, one per line. These are appended to the bundled list.

field.label: Enable Discord TCP TLS Profile
field.help: Apply a separate TLS profile for ports 443,2053,2083,2087,2096,8443 to the bundled Discord domain list before the generic TCP profile.

field.label: Discord TCP Strategy
field.help: When the profile is enabled, provide verified zapret2 TLS arguments such as --payload=tls_client_hello --lua-desync=.... Do not include --new, filters, hostlists, paths, or shell syntax.

field.label: Additional Discord Domains
field.help: Optional extra hostlist entries, one per line. These are appended to the bundled list.

field.label: Enable IPSet Include Filter
field.help: When enabled, apply zapret2 only to destination addresses present in the selected IPSet file. Place an IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR per line under /usr/local/etc/zapret2/. The file is validated before interception starts.

field.label: IPSet Include Filename
field.help: Filename under /usr/local/etc/zapret2 (default: ipset-all.txt). Do not enter a directory path.

field.label: Enable IPSet Exclude Filter
field.help: When enabled, skip zapret2 for destination addresses present in the selected IPv4/IPv6 CIDR file. The default file includes common local, private, link-local, multicast, and carrier-grade NAT ranges.

field.label: IPSet Exclude Filename
field.help: Filename under /usr/local/etc/zapret2 (default: ipset-exclude-default.txt). Do not enter a directory path.

field.label: Host List Mode
field.help:
All traffic — apply DPI bypass to all traffic on configured ports.
Only listed domains — apply only to domains listed below.
Auto-detect — automatically detect and add blocked domains.

field.label: Domains
field.help: One domain per line. Only used when Host List Mode is set to "Only listed domains".

field.label: Exclude Domains
field.help:
Domains to exclude from DPI bypass (one per line). Traffic to these domains will pass through unmodified.
Use this if zapret2 breaks connectivity to specific sites (e.g. government portals, banking sites).
